title: GIANT Region View
bodyHtml:
Associations can be compared by phenotype, sex and ancestry.

Available data per sex

  • BMI_GIANT: Mixed
  • HEIGHT_GIANT: Mixed
  • WHRadjBMI_GIANT: Male, Female, Mixed
  • WHRU_GIANT: Male, Female, Mixed

LD information comes from the 1000 Genomes phase 3 (version 5) reference panel, via the Michigan Imputation Server.

If you visualize a single-ancestry dataset, LD information is drawn from that population. Datasets with "Mixed" ancestry are mapped to the "All" population of 1000 Genomes.
